translations.ui.d398ae18ddb4: Wuxuu abuuraa kalfadhi dhinaca server-ka; wicitaan PSTN lama sheego ilaa bixiyaha isgaarsiinta uu u diro dhacdada webhook ammaan ah.
translations.ui.07ddb7f340fd: IVR: Riix 1 khalad, 2 ballan, 3 wakiilka taageerada.
translations.ui.8ef964729e07: Wuxuu soo qaadaa wicitaanka ugu da'da weyn ee safka ku jira oo u xilsaara wakiilka ugu fiican ee la heli karo (iswaafajinta xirfadda, ka dibna sugitaanka ugu dheer). Go'aan xilsaarid kaliya — macnaheedu maaha isku xirka telefoon dhabta ah.
translations.ui.9077c50d8036: Aqoonsiga kalfadhiga wicitaanka ee la sii daayo
translations.ui.43db61570404: Khariidadu waxay isticmaashaa Leaflet iyo xogta nool /v1/gis/fleet. UI ma abuuro dhibco baabuur.
translations.ui.17a1e3ec5d4a: Kamarada iyo browser-ku waxay si maxalli ah u qabtaan caddaynta. Isku-duwayaasha waxay ka yimaadaan GPS, ka dibna caddaynta waxaa loo diri karaa server-ka iyadoo la isticmaalayo tigidhka la oggolaaday.
translations.ui.06fa943be019: Kala-sarayntu waa go'an: degdegga SLA + iswaafajinta xirfadda + masaafada + culayska shaqada. Server-ku waa awoodda xilsaarida.
translations.ui.f1a80e3e8395: Kani ma aha shaashad qurxin. Liiska hoose waxaa laga dhisay tixraaca HTML ee ku lifaaqan waxaana lagu kala saaraa awood kasta iyadoo lagu salaynayo caddaynta hirgelinta kaydka. Magaca astaantu macnaheedu maaha in astaantu dhammaystiran tahay.
translations.ui.1e22c22f5622: Akhrinta xisaabta kaliya PostgreSQL. Ma jiro AI CEO madax-bannaan, ma jiro fulinta maaliyadeed madax-bannaan, mana jiraan natiijooyin la jilay oo loo soo bandhigay xaqiiqo ahaan.
translations.ui.82b3e49eb975: Qorsheyn → GIS → BOQ → Oggolaansho → Dhisme → Fiilo → Isku-xirid → Tijaabo iftiin → QC → Aqbalaad → Drop → ONT → Router → Firfircoonayn
translations.ui.1bd41c8b8b5a: Madaxweynaha shirkadda → Ku-xigeenno → Madaxda qaybaha → Madaxa qaybta → Maamulaha guud → Maamulaha xafiiska dhexe → Hogaamiyaha kooxda → Farsamayaqaan
translations.ui.53843646caad: La helay → La keydiyay → La soo saaray → La wareejiyay → La rakibay/La isticmaalay → La soo celiyay/La dhaawacay/La tirtiray
translations.ui.ddf413a199e7: Dushaani ma abuuro tirooyin: marka API/DB aan la heli karin, waxay muujisaa xaalad aan la heli karin halkii xog been ah.
translations.ui.fe1b878224ed: Hawlgalka goobta dhabta ah: kamarad + OCR + GPS + caddayn + xiritaan awood server. Lama bixiyo xogta GPS/serial ee caadiga ah.
